screen: Talent > Internal Mobility & Succession Center + Offboarding Center (unit tm-mobility-offboard)
screenLevelGaps: SUSPICION CONFIRMED (succession): readiness is NOT consumed from Competency, it is typed by hand. mobility-center.tsx:2096-2105 is a free Select of 'Ready Now'/'Ready in 1-2 Years'/'Ready in 2+ Years'; MobilitySuccessionController.php:68 validates it as an enum string and stores it verbatim. Zero references to s_skill_matrix, user_rating_details, s_users_skills or any gap score exist anywhere under app/Http/Controllers/Api/Mobility/ (verified by grep). Succession does not recompute readiness either - it simply asks a human.

SUSPICION CONFIRMED (internal job matching): job postings carry NO competency requirement. The Create/Edit Job drawers (mobility-center.tsx:1758-1894, 1905-2034) expose 11 fields, none of them skills; MobilityJobController::store validates 13 attributes, none skill-related. Applications (MobilityApplicationController::store) record only job_posting_id + user_id + free-text remarks. There is no fit score, no match %, no shortlist ranking, no read of the applicant's competency profile anywhere.

SUSPICION PARTLY WRONG (headcount/role update on movement): transfers and promotions DO write back to the org system of record. MobilityTransferController::completeTransferInProfile (:136-155) sets tbluser.department_id + allocated_standards; MobilityPromotionController::completePromotionInProfile (:128-172) sets tbluser.allocated_standards and upserts org_designation.designation/level. Because Competency reads tbluser.allocated_standards as the role id (CareerPathController.php:739, CertificationController.php:1328, DevelopmentPlanController.php:305, SkillHeatmapController.php:56, UserProfileController.php:41), the spec's 'promotion/transfer event -> re-maps required competency set' is implicitly satisfied. It is a shared-column side effect, not an event - app/Events, app/Listeners, app/Observers do not exist.

DATA-CORRUPTION RISK on that same path: allocated_standards is set to `$jobroleId ?: $transfer->to_jobrole` (Transfer:145) and `$jobroleId ?: $promo->proposed_designation` (Promotion:137). 'To Role' (mobility-center.tsx:2188) and 'Proposed Designation' (:2294) are free-text Inputs, not pickers, so any typo writes a NON-NUMERIC string into a column that Competency parses as a role id and SkillHeatmapController.php:56 aliases directly as jobrole_id. One promotion with a designation that is not a row in s_user_jobrole silently detaches that employee from their competency framework.

SUSPICION CONFIRMED (offboarding does nothing on exit): OffboardingController.php contains no write to tbluser, no write to the `task` table, no revocation of tokens/rights, no succession trigger. 'Access Revocation', 'Email Deactivation', 'Laptop Return' etc (OffboardingController.php:17-26 DEFAULT_CLEARANCE_TASKS) are literal strings inside a JSON blob; toggling one to 'Cleared' only rewrites clearance_tasks JSON + appends an activity_log line. Closing a case (updateStatus 'Closed') changes one varchar. The departing employee stays fully active in tbluser.

KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER IS DECORATION: the only 'Complete knowledge transfer' element (offboarding-center.tsx:1366-1376) is a static div with a fake radio glyph, no onClick, no persisted field. 'View All Actions (4)' (:1389) has no handler. Handover Progress 60% and Clearance Progress 30% (:1402, :1410) are literal constants even though real clearance_tasks are already loaded on the same object.

STATUS VOCABULARY SPLIT ON ONE TABLE - the single most damaging defect found. talent_offboarding_cases is backed by TWO Eloquent models: TalentOffboardingCase (used by this screen) and OffboardingCase (used by Api/Talent/OffboardingCaseController). OffboardingCase::STATUSES (model :32-35) is lowercase-hyphen ['initiated','notice-period','clearance','exit-interview','awaiting-fnf','closed','cancelled'] and EXIT_TYPES is ['resignation','termination','retirement','end-of-contract','absconding']. This screen writes 'Notice Period' / 'Clearance' / 'Awaiting F&F' / 'Closed' and exit_type 'voluntary'/'involuntary'. Result: TalentDashboardController.php:164 `whereIn('status', OffboardingCase::ACTIVE_STATUSES)` matches NONE of them - the Talent dashboard's Offboarding KPI reads 0 no matter how many exits this screen registers.

varchar OVERFLOW: migration 2026_07_30_120001:49 declares `status` as string(20) with an explicit comment that a longer value 'would be truncated on write and then never match the ACTIVE_STATUSES filter'. This screen's status pill and OffboardingController::updateStatus both allow 'Resignation Submitted' = 21 chars. Selecting that status truncates to 'Resignation Submitte', after which the row matches no filter in either implementation.

CLEARANCE STORED TWICE, READ FROM THE WRONG PLACE: this screen keeps clearance in the JSON column clearance_tasks (added by migration 2026_08_02_100000), while the relational table talent_offboarding_clearances exists and is what TalentDashboardController::pendingClearances (:410) and Api/Talent/OffboardingClearanceController use. Nothing bridges them, so the dashboard 'Clearances Pending' tile is blind to every clearance action taken on this screen.

MOBILITY IS INVISIBLE TO THE TALENT DASHBOARD: this screen writes s_mobility_jobs / _applications / _transfers / _promotions / _succession_plans, but TalentDashboardController's mobility feed queries `talent_mobility_requests` (:140) - a completely different table fed by Api/Talent/MobilityRequestController. Two parallel mobility products ship in the same build.

THE EMPLOYEE-FACING INTERNAL JOB BOARD IS UNREACHABLE. The 'Apply Internally' dialog exists in full (mobility-center.tsx:2039-2064) with a working submit handler, but grep shows setIsApplyJobOpen(true) is never called from anywhere - only setIsApplyJobOpen(false) at :408 and the Cancel button at :2059. The spec's Employee right 'Internal job board - view & apply to internal openings' has no entry point; applications can only ever arrive via a direct API call.

OFFBOARDING NEVER FEEDS SUCCESSION. An exit case names the departing employee (employee_id) but no code checks s_mobility_succession_plans for a role that person occupies, nor opens a vacancy, nor flags a slate as broken. Conversely s_mobility_jobs.current_incumbent is a free-text Input (:1871) rather than an employee reference, so a job opened to backfill a leaver cannot be joined to the exit case.

NO APPROVAL WORKFLOW EXISTS ANYWHERE IN MOBILITY, despite the spec requiring 'internal mobility approval workflow' for HR Manager and department-head nomination. The job sidebar Approvals tab (:1305-1321) is two hardcoded names. Transfers/promotions have an 'Approved' enum value the UI can set on create but the list actions only offer Complete/Cancel, so 'Approved' is a dead state.

F&F AND PAYROLL ARE NOT INTEGRATED: 'Generate F&F' (:1476) only calls updateStatus('Awaiting F&F'). Nothing computes dues, and 'Final Dues Calculation' is another JSON checklist string. Spec item 'Full & final settlement workflow coordination with Payroll' is unimplemented. Alumni/rehire-eligibility tracking is absent entirely.

TENANT LEAK + SOFT-DELETE LEAK in mobility reference data: MobilityOverviewController::filters queries hrms_departments with NO sub_institute_id predicate (:162-165) and tbluser with no whereNull('deleted_at') and no limit (:167-171). The offboarding equivalent scopes both correctly (OffboardingController.php:130-134, :147-153), so the two Talent screens disagree on tenant isolation.

EXIT INTERVIEW INSIGHT IS A DEAD END: notes are free text on the case row with no reason taxonomy beyond the 6-item dropdown, no sentiment/theme extraction, and no route into Competency or LMS. Nothing correlates exit reason with competency gap or with training history.

It does not deactivate the user, does not revoke tokens or menu rights, does not reassign `task` rows, does not decrement headcount, does not open a backfill posting, does not touch any succession plan naming the leaver, and does not check that mandatory clearances or documents are complete first.
Soft-deletes the case rather than setting a 'cancelled' status, so withdrawn resignations vanish from attrition history entirely.
Counts only 'Cleared', while the progress % helper also counts 'N/A' - the two numbers on the same screen disagree by design.
No asset module link; the checklist is 8 hardcoded strings identical for every tenant and role, non-configurable from the UI.

features.shouldFeed: Attrition drivers; Competency/LMS if the driver is growth or skills
features.gap: The placeholder solicits culture/salary/management themes but nothing is structured, coded, aggregated or routed. This is the single richest retention signal in the product and it terminates in a text column.

features.element: Exit Interview: Save Exit Interview File
features.gap: Saving with the checkbox unticked nulls the date and notes (all three fields are written unconditionally).
Every entry renders with a green check icon regardless of action type, so a rejection looks like a success.
No notification; every comment also bumps refreshTrigger and re-fetches filters, overview, the case list and the case.

features.reads: tbluser (excludes users with an open case)
features.gap: Its onChange also auto-assigns manager_id to 'any other employee in the same department' (:1722) - an arbitrary colleague, not the real reporting manager. It also sets a department_id key that is not part of CasePayload and is silently discarded by the service.
Writes 'voluntary'/'involuntary' into a column documented for ['resignation','termination','retirement','end-of-contract','absconding'] - retirement and end-of-contract are unrepresentable.

Reasons are hardcoded in BOTH the component and OffboardingController::filters:169-176; the fetched list is never used by this dropdown. Also the 'Termination' option's value is 'Involuntary/Termination', so label and value diverge.

features.element: Create Exit Case: Last Working Day
features.shouldFeed: Access revocation, payroll cutoff, task reassignment, headcount forecast
features.gap: Defaults to notice+30 days in JS; validated after_or_equal:notice_date but drives nothing downstream.
Pre-populated with the arbitrary same-department guess; backend falls back to employee.reportmanager only when the field is empty, so the guess overrides the truth.

features.element: Create Exit Case: Campus / Work Location
features.gap: Free text; backend falls back to tbluser.city.

features.shouldFeed: Succession (incumbent leaving), Mobility (open a backfill), Task Mgmt, Talent dashboard
features.gap: Creates an isolated record. No succession plan is consulted for the role being vacated, no backfill posting is offered, no tasks are surfaced, and status 'Notice Period' is invisible to the Talent dashboard KPI.

features.element: Extend Notice: New Last Working Day
features.gap: Starts blank rather than prefilled, because the API returns lastWorkingDay pre-formatted as 'd M Y' which a date input cannot consume. No check that the new date is later than the old one.
No consumer of the changed date.

features.shouldFeed: Task Mgmt: move task.task_allocated_to to this user
features.gap: No task, project, approval or direct-report is moved. This is the customer's 'task reassignment' question answered: it does not happen.

features.shouldFeed: Notification to the new handover lead
features.gap: No notification is raised.
